intro: Redefining Modern Warfare: Breach and Conquer the Uncharted Fortress
description:
"Before the lights of the world go out, crush the heart of destruction."

A covert sector hidden from all satellite networks. This is the birthplace of global annihilation, where the rogue cartel 'Black Octave' is manufacturing 'ORION'—the ultimate weapon system designed to end humanity. A providential frequency fracture caught during a recon mission has exposed its coordinates, but the final countdown to stop it has already begun.

The ultimate fusion of next-generation photorealism and cutting-edge siege warfare. Witness the absolute peak of realistic destruction, experience it now in .

* VISUAL OVERWHELM AND EXTREME MOBILITY
Choose the mode that suits your preference: 'Quality Mode,' which changes the very atmosphere of the battlefield with intricate details that blur the boundaries of reality, or 'Performance Mode,' which drives victory with smooth operation that captures every fleeting moment.

* EVERY ANGLE IS AN ENTRY POINT
There are no designated routes when breaching a weapon design bureau erased from the map. Utilize the terrain of a massive open field to execute a stealth flank on the fortress's vulnerable rear, or brave the curtain of fire to smash through the front gates. Your choice defines the tactics.

* EVOLVED TANKS, UNBOUND FIREPOWER
Take command of next-generation evolutionary tanks that transcend simple transport vehicles. Adapt your armor's loadout in real-time to counter active defense systems, and unleash unrestricted offensive fire unhindered by angles or topography to neutralize defensive turrets and seize control at lightning speed.

* SHATTERING THE ABSOLUTE BASTION | The Four Spears
ASSAULT: The ultimate vanguard of the frontline, diving headfirst into breached walls to rip through enemy defenses.
ENGINEER: The core of the siege, specialized in hacking security networks and demolishing blast doors to paralyze the fortress interior.
SUPPORT: The immovable shield, sustaining the squad through brutal breaches with heavy fire support and constant ammunition supply.
RECON: The tactical eyes in the dark, detecting ambush points inside the uncharted stronghold and eliminating high-value targets with surgical precision.

* ALL-OUT WARFARE TO DESTROY THE DEFENSE LINE
Savor the raw survival instincts of Deathmatch as you wipe out external security outposts, then transition to Conquest and Rush modes to systematically seize core control rooms and detonate the facility from the inside out. Eradicate the enemy’s final defense grid with meticulously calculated teamwork.

* THE HEART OF THE DEADZONE | Ultimate Infiltration
From the ironclad desert base choked by blinding sandstorms to the subterranean secret factory dominated by scalding steam—prove your status as a tier-one operator by piercing through suffocating pressure to conquer the hidden heart of the cartel.

< SYNOPSIS : A Looming Shadow >
In an era where national borders have dissolved, the world lies in the iron grip of ‘Black Octave’, a private military-technological cartel. Within their newly exposed stronghold, the production lines of the doomsday design bureau are coming online for final activation.

You are an elite operator of the world’s most lethal special operations group, tasked with cutting out the heart of this invisible evil and bringing down their fortress. Track the cartel's leader hidden within the Iron Labyrinth, and halt the hands of the doomsday clock closing in on the world.

The operation is already underway. Deploy with your brothers-in-arms and conquer the ultimate siege mission waiting on the brink of hell.
